private theorem nodup_of_strict_chain
    (values : List String)
    (ordered : values.IsChain (· < ·)) :
    values.Nodup :=
  (List.isChain_iff_pairwise.mp ordered).nodup

private theorem append_strict_chains
    {left right : List String}
    {leftLast rightFirst : String}
    (leftChain : left.IsChain (· < ·))
    (rightChain : right.IsChain (· < ·))
    (leftLastProof : left.getLast? = some leftLast)
    (rightHeadProof : right.head? = some rightFirst)
    (boundary : leftLast < rightFirst) :
    (left ++ right).IsChain (· < ·) := by
  apply List.IsChain.append leftChain rightChain
  intro x hx y hy
  have x_eq : leftLast = x := by
    simpa [leftLastProof] using hx
  have y_eq : rightFirst = y := by
    simpa [rightHeadProof] using hy
  subst x
  subst y
  exact boundary
